name: Bambuddy
description: Connects to printers managed by Bambuddy. Receives real-time AMS data and idempotent modern spool usage events via WebSocket, with legacy print completion compatibility.
author: FilaMan

sync_enabled.title: Inventar-Synchronisation
sync_enabled.description: Wenn aktiviert, werden FilaMan-Spulen automatisch ins Bambuddy-Inventar synchronisiert. Bei Deaktivierung nutzt Bambuddy die Spoolman API.

printer_write_mode.title: Printer Write Mode
printer_write_mode.description: Full applies filament and calibration settings to the printer; Inventory only keeps Bambuddy inventory and assignment state without printer material writes.

bambuddy_url.title: Bambuddy URL
bambuddy_url.description: Base URL of your Bambuddy instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8080

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Bambuddy API key (create in Bambuddy under Settings → API Keys)

printer_id.title: Bambuddy Printer ID
printer_id.description: Internal ID of the printer in Bambuddy

reconnect_interval_seconds.title: WebSocket Reconnect Interval (Seconds)
reconnect_interval_seconds.description: How long to wait before reconnecting after a WebSocket disconnect

sync_interval_seconds.title: Sync-Intervall (Sekunden)
sync_interval_seconds.description: Wie oft FilaMan-Spulen mit Bambuddy abgeglichen werden

per_model_profiles.title: Per-Model Slicer Profiles
per_model_profiles.description: When enabled, cloud profiles are stored per printer model (P2S, H2C, etc.) with automatic nozzle resolution. Disable to fall back to single-profile behavior.

per_printer_profiles.title: Per-Printer Slicer Profiles (legacy alias)
per_printer_profiles.description: Deprecated alias for per_model_profiles. When enabled, picking a cloud profile resolves and stores a separate printer/nozzle-specific variant (PFUS) per printer model, and the AMS configure call sends the correct profile as setting_id.

fields.label: Default Nozzle Diameter (mm)
fields.description: Only used when Bambuddy does not report the installed nozzle size. Update when you swap nozzles.
